notes.title: DEVLOG - #001
notes.content:
Hi everyone, welcome to Devlog # 1!
[i]Text translated into English by google[/i]

I have finished the energy storage and management system that will be housed in the ship's battery rooms.

The energy system is made up of a control panel that can house a maximum of 26 energy cells, collects its telemetry in real-time, indicating the state of the battery (energy, integrity, temperature ...). The control panel sends these data to the room control, which in turn sends them to the control of the ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37645611/b8afd99621ad892efc4e932b79f9513d5d6bae2d.png[/img]

Each room has a room control called "Mechanisms" which collects the energy consumed and sends it to the ship control. The ship control compares the energy generated with that consumed, if the energy consumed is greater than that produced, the power in the affected deck will be cut.

The room control is a mechanism box, as can be seen in the following image

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37645611/14809658038d3e55a0e751e8b8ff5dc62219e71b.png[/img]

[b]CELULAS DE ENERGÍA[/b]

Each power cell has a shutdown button in case it overheats, we can see directly in the cell if it is heating up due to the different colors that the heatsink can see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37645611/6d144e72e63cc6e4e72e278d25769858af628888.png[/img]
